title: Snowflake invoice ingestion and refresh workflow
problem: Invoice Excel files currently require a repeatable manual process to prepare and refresh invoice reconciliation data.
proposed_solution: Save the carrier workbook to its controlled folder; run the preparation script; review the generated upload package and control totals; upload it to Snowflake; refresh raw, charge-line, component, consignment and reconciliation tables.
expected_benefit: Repeatable monthly invoice loads; preserved source evidence; safer revisions; faster Finance validation; less manual handling.
dependencies: Confirm Snowflake database, schemas, landing stage, role permissions and the table-refresh stored procedure.
next_decision: Approve the target Snowflake objects and implement the upload and refresh procedure.

title: Store last-mile costs and end-to-end order split costing
problem: The current app cannot show the full last-mile cost of a customer order when OMFP splits an External_Order_ID across Store and CFC fulfilment orders or across multiple nodes.
proposed_solution: Bring Store and CFC fulfilment records into a common model; link External_Order_ID to Fulfillment Order or Order_ID and then to Shippit invoice or consignment identifiers; retain node, carrier, service, tracking, parcel and product counts, physical measures, quoted cost and delivery events; allow multiple carriers per fulfilment order as a measured possibility rather than assuming it cannot occur.
expected_benefit: Finance can calculate total customer-order cost, quantify the cost of order splits, compare node fulfilment economics and identify carrier or node-assignment optimisation opportunities.
dependencies: Confirm the OMFP order and fulfilment identifiers; identify the Store source and cost fields; confirm whether Order_ID is always one-to-one with a Shippit consignment; determine how CFC zero quoted cost should be replaced or reconciled to actual invoice cost.
next_decision: Approve the source tables and relationship rules, then build a sample order-level lineage and costing view before scaling to the full history.
